ALL YOU NEED

Q
01
IF THE HOTEL IS NOT FULL, WHO GUARANTEES THE INCOME?

REVENUE DEPENDS ON REAL WORKLOAD, BUT OUR FINANCIAL MODEL IS BUILT ON CONSERVATIVE INDICATORS (237 DAYS/YEAR). IN ADDITION, THERE IS AN OPERATING COMPANY THAT IS RESPONSIBLE FOR MARKETING AND BOOKING.

02
CAN I LIVE IN MY APARTMENT?

YES, UP TO 30 DAYS A YEAR FOR FREE. THE REST OF THE TIME THE APARTMENT WORKS AS A HOTEL ROOM AND BRINGS INCOME.

03
WHAT IF I WANT TO SELL AN APARTMENT?

YOU CAN SELL IT AT ANY TIME. YAREMCHE'S MARKET CAPITALIZATION IS GROWING BY 18% EVERY YEAR, SO RESALE CAN BE PROFITABLE ALREADY AT THE CONSTRUCTION STAGE.

04
WHY ARE INVESTORS PAID DIVIDENDS PER SQUARE METER?

THIS IS A FAIR SYSTEM: THE LARGER THE AREA OF THE APARTMENT, THE HIGHER THE INCOME. FOR EXAMPLE, 37.23 M² — ≈ 13 030 $/YEAR.

05
ARE THERE ANY GUARANTEES THAT THE CONSTRUCTION WILL BE COMPLETED?

THE CONSTRUCTION IS CARRIED OUT IN STAGES: SECTION 1 — IV QUARTER 2027, SECTION 2 — I SQ. IN 2028. THERE IS AN APPROVED SCHEDULE, LICENSES, OPEN DOCUMENTS AND A PARTNER CONSTRUCTION COMPANY WITH EXPERIENCE IN THE IMPLEMENTATION OF LARGE OBJECTS.

06
WHY NOT JUST BUY AN APARTMENT IN YAREMCHE AND RENT IT YOURSELF?

BECAUSE IT'S A DIFFERENT SEGMENT. THE APARTHOTEL PROVIDES: PROFESSIONAL SERVICE, BOOKING THROUGH INTERNATIONAL SYSTEMS, MARKETING AND STABLE OCCUPANCY. SELF-RENTAL RARELY EXCEEDS 20— 30% OF THE LOAD.

07
WHO RUNS THE HOTEL?

MANAGEMENT IS CARRIED OUT BY A PROFESSIONAL MANAGEMENT COMPANY WITH EXPERIENCE IN THE HOTEL BUSINESS. THIS IS THE KEY DIFFERENCE FROM “APARTMENT FOR RENT”.

08
HOW ARE DIVIDENDS PAID?
